sources.citation: Hartmann(-So), Helga. 1988. Notes on the Southern Chin languages. Linguistics of the Tibeto-Burman Area 11(2): 98-119.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Gives a Matu (Nga La/Va Lang) Swadesh wordlist and segmental correspondences; p.98: 'Tone and/or register was not marked consistently in most of the lists, so I have not attempted to discuss it.' Notes Matu has final /-l, -r/, prenasalization AND presyllables. No word-stress statement.
